digest.component_or_area: LLM usage logging for weekly live-LLM CI jobs
propositions: The two weekly billable LLM jobs (external and eval-live) produce no retrievable record of token usage despite per-call usage already being captured in the runner.
Per-call usage attached as result['_usage'] is dropped by the eval path and swallowed by the NullHandler-suppressed INFO logs, never reaching either weekly job.
A new opt-in usage sink module records token usage (input/output/cache tokens + request count) as JSONL when REBAR_USAGE_LOG is set, and is a no-op when unset.
The runner calls usage_log.record at the existing _usage seam so a single hook covers both jobs without per-test or per-eval plumbing.
A summarize CLI emits a Markdown totals and per-op breakdown table (or 'No LLM calls recorded.' for empty/missing files) for use in the GitHub step summary.
Both weekly workflows set REBAR_USAGE_LOG, append the summary with if:always(), and upload the raw JSONL as a durable artifact.
